claims.quote: Our finding further confirms the association of homozygous, loss-of-function variants in DNM1 associated with DEE type 31B.
RT-qPCR revealed a substantial reduction of the DNM1 gene in the index patient.
3D protein modeling showed that the mutant protein would lose most of the amino acids and might not perform the proper function if the surveillance non-sense-mediated decay mechanism was skipped.
